snippet.title: Captain Speedfin - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet Captain Speedfin, a pirate with one big problem: an hourglass that's about to run out. Your mission is simple—but not easy. You must navigate through 60 intense, platforming levels to retrieve your chests before time expires.

Wishlist now : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4017940/Captain_Speedfin/
